title: The resource for s3:ListAllMyBuckets
question: Which resource does a request for an action with no resource type use? AWS's own examples allow s3:ListAllMyBuckets on arn:aws:s3:::*, but the analyzer only matches the request's * against a policy's * (review open question 3).

cases.name: allowed_on_every_bucket_arn
cases.description: An Allow on arn:aws:s3:::*, as in AWS's examples.

readings.ALLOW: arn:aws:s3:::* covers a request with no resource, as AWS's examples assume
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: it doesn't, as the analyzer says today
